programme.desc: 'S4/E1 - Sinker's Holiday'. Captain Sinker enters a selfie competition to try and win the best holiday ever! Later, Paige, Katie, Alex and Paul take on the Shipwreck Rummage.

programme.desc: 'S1/E52 - Verandah Santa'. It's Christmas Eve and Dad and the kids are taking turns pretending to be Santa.
